    Questions

    Before you buy.

    Do I need a gym?

    No. The Home edition uses a pull-up bar (or a sturdy table), a backpack you can load with books, a chair, a resistance band and two water jugs. The Gym edition uses a barbell, dumbbells, a cable or pulldown machine, a pull-up bar and a bench.

    Can I switch between gym and home?

    Each edition is its own PDF. Pick the one that matches where you train. If your situation changes, you can get the other edition.

    I am a beginner. Is this too hard?

    No. Your Wolf rank tells you which version of every exercise to use. Pup rank starts with the easier versions, and each exercise card shows an easier and a harder option.

    How is it delivered?

    As a PDF download right after checkout. It works on a phone, tablet or computer, and every exercise name inside is a tappable link to its step-by-step card.

    Does the tracker really save my progress?

    In RELENTLESS Ultimate, yes. The logbook cells are fillable. Type in them, save the file, and your entries stay inside the PDF. Use Adobe Acrobat Reader, Apple Preview, or Chrome or Edge on a computer. On a phone, use the free Adobe Acrobat Reader app. Quick-preview windows inside messaging apps may not save typing.

    What about food?

    RELENTLESS Pro and Ultimate include a food guide written with US foods and units. Ultimate adds a 4-week meal plan with a vegetarian version.

    Is this medical advice?

    No. This is general fitness information. Talk to a doctor before starting a new program, especially if you have an injury or health condition. Stop any exercise that causes pain.

    RELENTLESS by Wolfra
